# AGENTS.md — mis-backend

<!-- Generated by mis-workspace ONBOARDING.md from the repo profile. This is now the repo's own contract, so maintain it here. -->

## Purpose

Laravel 12 API for the MIS project. It receives RFID card scans from the Arduino scanner firmware (`arduino-rfid-scanner`), records attendance, relays card UIDs to the admin UI for card→student assignment, and serves the admin SPA (`mis-frontend`) and the student/parent app (`mis-mobile`). The RFID flow is rebuilt identically to `enrollment/mis-be`. Generator output (`laravel/laravel` + `php artisan install:api`); staff auth, school years, students, employees, grade levels, programs and terms implemented.

## Ownership

Owner: a.baladon@qstrike.com. Part of the `mis` project — shared plans, rules and wiki live in the workspace and are linked here at `.claude/common/` and `.claude/diagrams/`.

## Local Contracts

- Stack: php / Laravel ^12.0 (Sanctum ^4.0) · DB: postgres (tests: SQLite `:memory:`)
- Layer chain (build order): migration → model → factory → request → resource? → controller → route → test
- Coding rules: `.claude/rules/rules-common.md`, `.claude/rules/rules-backend.md`. Both are binding.
- Implementation agent: `be-developer`. Auditor: `be-auditor`.
- Plans for this repo: `.claude/common/plans/active/<slug>/plan-be.md`
- Route groups: device routes at the `/api` root, public. Every admin route under `Route::prefix('mis')` → `/api/mis/...`, behind `auth:sanctum` + admin/registrar role middleware. Auth done (mis-1): `POST /api/mis/login` public; everything else in `/api/mis` behind `auth:sanctum` + `role:admin,registrar` (staff group), plus a `role:admin` group for admin-only routes.
- Scanner contract (frozen; identical to `enrollment/mis-be`, matches the firmware — change only together with a firmware change):
  - `POST /api/scan` — JSON `{"rfid"}` — attendance. Student by `rfid` (404 `{message}` if none); first scan of the day creates `student_attendances` `time_in` + `status=present`, later scans set `time_out`; uses the **active school year**. 200 `{student, attendance}`.
  - `POST /api/rfid/scan` — form `rfid=` — assignment relay. 403 `{status, message}` unless cache `rfid_channel_opened` is set (by `/api/mis/rfid/open`, 300 s); else broadcasts `AssignRfid` (`message` = UID) on public channel `rfid`.
  - UID = uppercase hex bytes joined by `:` (4, 7 or 10 bytes). Firmware sends no Accept header → the api group forces `Accept: application/json`.
  - `students.rfid`: string, nullable, unique.
- Staff auth endpoints (mis-1, `AuthController`): `POST /api/mis/login` JSON `{email, password}` → 200 `{token, user}` or 422 `{message, errors}` (an inactive account with the right password gets 422 `errors.email` "This account is deactivated." and no token, mis-5); `GET /api/mis/user` → 200 `{user}`; `POST /api/mis/logout` → 204, revokes only the current token. `user` = `UserResource` `{id, name, email, roles: string[]}`. No valid token → 401 `{"message":"Unauthenticated."}`; no staff role → 403 `{"message":"Unauthorized"}`.
- Entity `school_years` (mis-3, `SchoolYear`): `name` string unique, `start_date` / `end_date` date, `description` text nullable, `term_type` string `semester`|`trimester` default `semester` (mis-11; required on create/update; cannot change while the year has terms), `is_active` boolean default false (not fillable; changed only by set-active, at most one active row).
- School-year endpoints (mis-3, `SchoolYearController`): `school_year` = `SchoolYearResource` `{id, name, start_date, end_date, description, term_type, terms_count, is_active, created_at, updated_at}` (10 keys since mis-11; `terms_count` = number of terms, dates `Y-m-d`, timestamps ISO-8601). Status precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404; ids numeric (`whereNumber`), else route 404.
  - `GET /api/mis/school-years` (admin) → 200 `{school_years: [school_year]}`, all rows, `start_date` desc then `id` desc.
  - `POST /api/mis/school-years` (admin) JSON `{name, start_date, end_date, term_type, description?}` → 201 `{school_year}` (`is_active` false) or 422 `{message, errors}`. Rules: name required, max 255, unique; dates `date_format:Y-m-d`, `end_date` after `start_date`; description nullable, max 1000; `term_type` required, `semester`|`trimester`. `is_active` in the body is ignored.
  - `PUT /api/mis/school-years/{id}` (admin) same body (unique ignores own row) → 200 `{school_year}`, `is_active` unchanged; 422; 404 `{message}`. With terms (mis-11): 422 `errors.term_type` when the type changes; 422 `errors.start_date` / `errors.end_date` when the new dates would leave a term outside (inclusive).
  - `DELETE /api/mis/school-years/{id}` (admin) → 204; 422 `{"message":"The active school year cannot be deleted."}` for the active row; 404. Deleting an inactive year deletes its terms (FK cascade, mis-11).
  - `PUT /api/mis/school-years/set-active/{id}` (admin) → 200 `{school_year}` (`is_active` true, all others false, and any active term of another year cleared, in one transaction with 3 attempts); 404 changes nothing.
  - `GET /api/mis/school-years/get-active` (admin, registrar) → 200 `{school_year}` or `{"school_year": null}`.
- Entity `terms` (mis-11, `Term`): `school_year_id` FK (cascade on delete), `term_number` (1–2 for semester years, 1–3 for trimester years; unique per year), `start_date` / `end_date` date, `is_active` boolean default false (not fillable; changed only by set-active; at most one active term, always in the active school year). Label computed, never stored: `Term::buildLabel()` → "1st Semester", "2nd Semester", "1st Trimester", "2nd Trimester", "3rd Trimester". Date rules: end strictly after start; both dates inside the year (inclusive); vs every other term of the year, a higher number starts strictly after a lower number ends (so no overlap, not even one shared day); terms may be added in any order.
- Term endpoints (mis-11, `TermController`): `term` = `TermResource` `{id, school_year_id, term_number, label, start_date, end_date, is_active, created_at, updated_at}`. `GET /api/mis/school-years/{id}/terms` (admin, registrar) → 200 `{terms: [term]}` by `term_number`, all rows; 404. `GET /api/mis/terms/get-active` (admin, registrar) → 200 `{term}` with nested `school_year`, or `{"term": null}`. Admin only: `POST /api/mis/school-years/{id}/terms` JSON `{term_number, start_date, end_date}` → 201 `{term}`; `PUT /api/mis/terms/{id}` same body → 200 `{term}`; `DELETE /api/mis/terms/{id}` → 204, 422 `{"message":"The active term cannot be deleted."}`; `PUT /api/mis/terms/set-active/{id}` (body-less) → 200 `{term}` (one transaction, 3 attempts), 422 `{"message":"Only a term of the active school year can be set active."}`. Write routes resolve the year/term before validation: 401 → 403 → 404 → 422. No deactivate route.
- Entity `students` (mis-4, `Student`): `lrn` string(12) unique (exactly 12 digits, validated); required `first_name`, `last_name`, `birth_date` (date, before today), `gender` (`Student::GENDERS`), `grade_level` (`Student::GRADE_LEVELS`, Grade 7 to 4th Year College), `section` (course for college), `guardian_name`, `guardian_relationship`, `guardian_contact` (max 20); nullable `middle_name`, `address`, `contact` (max 20); `rfid` nullable unique and `user_id` nullable unique FK to `users` (null on delete) are not fillable and never written by the student endpoints.
- Student endpoints (mis-4, `StudentController`, staff group: admin and registrar): `student` = `StudentResource` (17 keys, `birth_date` `Y-m-d`, `rfid` string or null, no `user_id`). `GET /api/mis/students?search=&grade_level=&section=&page=` → 200 `{students: [student], meta: {current_page, last_page, per_page, total}}`, 15 per page, `created_at` desc then `id` desc, search = every whitespace-split word in lrn/first/middle/last name (case-insensitive), no `per_page` param. `POST /api/mis/students` → 201 `{student}`; `PUT /api/mis/students/{id}` → 200 `{student}` (LRN unique ignores own row); `DELETE /api/mis/students/{id}` → 204. 422 `{message, errors}`; 404 `{message}`; `rfid`/`user_id` in a body are ignored. Status precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404.
- Entity `users` as employees (mis-5): adds `contact` string(20) nullable (fillable, max 20) and `is_active` boolean default true (not fillable; changed only by deactivate/reactivate). Inactive users cannot log in and hold no tokens.
- Employee endpoints (mis-5, `EmployeeController`, admin group): `employee` = `EmployeeResource` `{id, name, email, contact, is_active, roles: string[], created_at, updated_at}`. `GET /api/mis/employees?search=&role=&status=&page=` → 200 `{employees: [employee], meta}`, 15 per page, newest first, search = every word in name/email, `role` admin|registrar, `status` active|inactive. `POST /api/mis/employees` → 201 `{employee}` (password min 8 confirmed, roles ≥ 1 of admin/registrar). `PUT /api/mis/employees/{id}` → 200 `{employee}` (no password). `PUT /api/mis/employees/{id}/password` → 200 `{employee}`, revokes all its tokens. `PUT /api/mis/employees/{id}/deactivate` → 200 `{employee}`, revokes all its tokens; `/reactivate` → 200 `{employee}`. Safeguards (422): no self-deactivate, no removing your own admin role, the last active admin cannot be deactivated or lose admin. Search/page meta shared via `Concerns\SearchesPaginatedLists`.
- Entity `grade_levels` (mis-10, `GradeLevel`): `name` string unique, `sort_order` unique (1–10), `stage` `jhs`|`shs`|`college` (`GradeLevel::STAGES`; programs use `GradeLevel::PROGRAM_STAGES` = shs, college). Exactly 10 fixed rows (Grade 7–10 jhs, Grade 11–12 shs, 1st–4th Year College college; names = `Student::GRADE_LEVELS`) inserted by the create migration itself, so they exist after `migrate` and in every test without `db:seed`. No write endpoints.
- Entity `programs` (mis-10, `Program`): `code` string(20) unique, stored upper-case (trimmed + upper-cased before validation, so uniqueness ignores case); required `name` (max 255) and `stage` (`shs`|`college`); `description` text nullable (max 1000); `is_active` boolean default true (not fillable; changed only by deactivate/reactivate). A program covers every grade level of its stage (shared stage value, no relation). The demo seeder adds STEM, ABM, HUMSS, GAS, TVL (shs) and BSIT, BSCS, BSBA (college) once each, keyed on code.
- Grade-level and program endpoints (mis-10, `GradeLevelController`, `ProgramController`): `GET /api/mis/grade-levels` (admin, registrar) → 200 `{grade_levels: [{id, name, stage, sort_order}]}`, all 10 by `sort_order`. `program` = `ProgramResource` `{id, code, name, stage, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at}`. `GET /api/mis/programs?search=&stage=&status=&page=` (admin, registrar) → 200 `{programs: [program], meta}`, 15 per page, `code` asc, search = every word in code/name, `stage` shs|college, `status` active|inactive, inactive rows listed by default. Admin only: `POST /api/mis/programs` → 201 `{program}`; `PUT /api/mis/programs/{id}` → 200 `{program}`; `PUT /api/mis/programs/{id}/deactivate` and `/reactivate` → 200 `{program}` (body-less, idempotent); `DELETE /api/mis/programs/{id}` → 204 (hard delete; the in-use block comes with MIS-12). 422 `{message, errors}`; 404 `{message}`.
- Roles: `roles` + `role_user` pivot (many-to-many); names are `Role::ADMIN` / `Role::REGISTRAR` constants (`Role::STAFF_ROLES`). `User::hasAnyRole()` is the role check.
- Middleware: `role:` alias → `RoleMiddleware` (any-match, 403 `{message}`); `ForceJsonResponse` prepended to the api group in `bootstrap/app.php` (built in mis-1).
- Errors are always JSON; validation via FormRequest or `$request->validate()`; list endpoints `paginate()`, except `GET /api/mis/school-years` (all rows, decided mis-3 AMBIGUITY-5); the students list pages 15 per page under a `meta` key (mis-4); the employees list does the same (mis-5), and so does the programs list (mis-10); `GET /api/mis/grade-levels` returns all rows (mis-10).

## Work Guidance

- Run: `php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8000` · Test: `php artisan test` · Lint: `./vendor/bin/pint`
- Ports: 8000
- Migrate `php artisan migrate` · routes `php artisan route:list` · full dev stack `composer run dev` · first-time setup `composer run setup`
- Create files with `php artisan make:*`; controllers stay thin; no logic in route closures; config via `config()`, never `env()` outside `config/`.
- Every new endpoint gets a Feature test (success + validation failure). Scanner endpoints are tested with the firmware encoding and no Accept header. Avoid Postgres-only SQL (tests run on SQLite).
- `db:seed` needs `SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL` / `SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` in `.env` (read via `config('auth.seed_admin.*')`); seeds roles + one admin; idempotent.
- Keep Laravel's unused frontend scaffolding (`resources/`, `vite.config.js`, `package.json`, `welcome` view).

## Verification

- `php artisan test` passes
- `be-auditor` passes on staged changes before commit

## Child DOX Index

- `app/` — models (`Models/`), HTTP controllers/requests/resources (`Http/`), middleware (`Http/Middleware`), providers
- `bootstrap/app.php` — routing (web, api, `/up`), middleware, exception hooks
- `config/` — framework config, including `sanctum.php`
- `database/` — migrations, factories, seeders
- `routes/` — `api.php` (all API routes), `web.php`, `console.php`
- `tests/` — `Feature/` (HTTP endpoints), `Unit/` (pure logic)
- `resources/`, `public/` — unused frontend scaffolding / entry point

After a meaningful change, update the closest owning AGENTS.md if purpose, structure, contracts, routes, entities, or workflows changed, and remove stale text.
